fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-html) spread the upstream ld+json NewsArticle/ReportageNewsArticle/Article node close to verbatim plus a scraped articleBody and a computed _paywalled flag (SPIEGEL+ premium articles have no HTML body at all, so articleBody is null and _paywalled is true rather than fabricating text), so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may appear. Latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields from the site-wide RSS feed.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-html, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

@type.title: Schema.org type
@type.description: Upstream ld+json node type: NewsArticle, ReportageNewsArticle, or Article.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, joined from div[data-area=body] > div[data-area=text] > p paragraphs. Null on SPIEGEL+ premium articles, which replace the text divs with a paywall placeholder and expose no body text at all (see _paywalled).

_paywalled.title: Paywalled
_paywalled.description: True when the article page renders div[data-area=paywall] instead of body text -- a hard paywall (no articleBody available), not a teaser.

author.title: Author
author.description: Author object(s) as emitted by upstream ld+json (raw passthrough).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated or array of keywords, as emitted upstream.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the RSS item (latest mode).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, with any URL fragment stripped (latest mode).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of RSS item <category> values (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
